scripts.test:prediction: esbuild scripts/test-prediction-knn.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --jsx=automatic --packages=external --alias:@=./src --outfile=node_modules/.tmp/test-prediction-knn.mjs && node node_modules/.tmp/test-prediction-knn.mjs && esbuild scripts/test-public-demo-landing.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --alias:@=./src --outfile=node_modules/.tmp/test-public-demo-landing.mjs && node node_modules/.tmp/test-public-demo-landing.mjs
